name: Expanding Photo Grid
description: Full-screen dark gallery showing one grayscale photo that expands on hover into a 3x3 grid, with a category menu sliding in, a logo that collapses to its initials, and a card that flips to reveal a quote.
contents: 3x3 grid of grayscale photo cards with number, title and subtitle captions
Logo text with gallery and series labels
Vertical category list on the right edge (desktop)
Flip card with quote and author on its back
behavior: Hovering the center card expands the other eight cards outward from the center with staggered easing
Category menu staggers in and the logo letters blur out and merge to initials while expanded
Hovering the flip card spins it in 3D to show a quote, leaving flips it back
Leaving the grid collapses it again
On touch devices, tapping the center card toggles expansion and tapping the flip card toggles the flip
Animated film grain overlay and edge vignette

props.name: mysteriousMessage
props.default: The magic lies within the seventh frame...

props.name: flipCardQuote
props.default: In the spaces between light and shadow, the unseen reveals itself. The photograph captures not just what is visible, but the mystery that lies beyond perception.

editableByProps: All card images, titles and subtitles
Logo text, labels, hint message, quote text and author, category names
Background color, grain on or off, expand and flip speeds

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which card sits in the center or the final grid positions

needsCodeEdit.where: vs-noise block and the radial-gradient div

needsCodeEdit.change: Show images in color instead of grayscale
needsCodeEdit.where: grayscale class on the img elements

fixed: Needs exactly 9 cards, the center card is index 4
Registers the GSAP CustomEase plugin and creates the customEase ease
Grain overlay, vignette, logo, hint message and category list are position fixed against the viewport
Category list is hidden below the md breakpoint
Root is a full viewport height section
